provenance: Inputs: the published signed contributions, modal metadata (mode, scope cluster, frequency) and rigid responses of analysis C10-W3 of validation/references/f2_spectrum/discrete/c10_cluster_witnesses.json (frozen), each as its binary64. This is a combination-unit contract fixture: its contributions were not produced by the product, it is not a spectrum solve result or a spectrum-1 document, and it has no standing as an engineering result.
statement: Unsigned combined magnitudes formed by the stated modal, rigid-response and directional combination rules from the supplied signed contributions, summing the modes of each supplied cluster with their signs first. Under an absolute-sum rule a magnitude is the sum of the magnitudes it combines. The contributions and their modal metadata are inputs to this unit; it forms no modal response, solves no eigenproblem or rigid response, and is not a response-spectrum analysis result. It establishes neither physical correctness nor code compliance.
